item.title: Solved: Top 5 Methods to Run a Python Script as a Windows Service
item.description:
How do you run a Python script as a service in Windows?

I am currently in the process of designing a system where several programs interact with interconnected objects stored in a database. One of these programs is intended to function as a service that provides a higher-level interface for operations on these objects, while other programs will access these objects through this service.

My preference is to utilize Python along with the Django framework to implement this service. I have a solid grasp of how to daemonize a Python program in a Linux environment, but I am now considering the feasibility of supporting Windows due to the specifications of the system. My experience with Windows programming is limited, especially when it comes to Windows services.
